/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from shutil import copyfile
from subprocess import run
import os
root = Path.cwd()
archive = 'engineering-tally-fixture-1.1.0.tgz'
with TemporaryDirectory(dir=root, prefix='.tally-acceptance.') as temp:
    work = Path(temp)
    copyfile(root / 'release' / archive, work / archive)
    config = dict(os.environ, npm_config_cache=str(work / '.npm-cache'),
                  npm_config_userconfig='/dev/null', npm_config_globalconfig='/dev/null',
                  npm_config_update_notifier='false')
    run(['npm', 'install', '--offline', '--ignore-scripts', '--no-audit', '--no-fund',
         './' + archive], cwd=work, env=config, check=True)
    for args, expected in [
        (['--version'], (0, '1.1.0\\n', '')),
        (['sum','2','3','--machine'], (0, '{\"sum\":5}\\n', '')),
        (['sum','bad','--machine'], (2, '', 'Number expected\\n')),
    ]:
        result = run(['./node_modules/.bin/tally', *args], cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True)
        observed = (result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
        print(args, observed)
        assert observed == expected
print('Disposable directory removed:', not work.exists())
PY"
